status: Private execution contract recorded before evaluation; no public/provider/owner admission
ownership: Existing providers/windows/storage_identity owns a pure immutable projection of actual owned /2 frames and composite identity. Runtime graph and cached presentation owners remain unchanged. No new host role, I/O, product composition, command, physical storage grant or public serialization ABI.
construction: Require actual non-null owned frame and immutable identity, exact current typed domain/source/capture/worker/frame/context binding. JSON cannot construct this projection. Optional comparison requires an actual previous projection and explicit bounded per-disk subject/digest bindings; reject absent previous, unused previous, duplicate current subjects, forged digests, foreign domains and invalid epoch/subject relations. Retain at most current and previous frame/identity values directly, never a chain of projection objects.
projection: Preserve existing frame detail nodes and exact IDs, then add one evidence-only storage-identity-observation row per resource linked from its original resource row. Each summary retains subject, composite observation ID, selected reported fingerprint, quality, collision-group and occurrence counts by kind, original claims and complete evidence references. Do not duplicate selected facts, original identifiers, collision keys or full changes into every row. Comparison summaries retain applicable and reported relations, qualities, declared continuity, changed component names and the complete comparison reference. No coalescence or automatic same-media inference.
retrieval: References identify complete frame, identity or comparison content by kind and exact SHA-256 within the retained native projection object. Resolution is read-only, returns the complete immutable value or refuses unknown kind/digest, and performs no file/path/network lookup. Retained previous frame/identity values support comparison references after previous projection destruction; there is no unbounded history chain. Serialized references alone cannot reconstruct native ownership, grant authority, guarantee persistence or resolve in another process. Cached consumers must retain the corresponding object for retrieval; this prototype does not advertise a public retrieval command.
publication: Projection alone does not publish or retire readers. Existing cached frontend session consumes the graph as evidence. Actual current/partial graphs retain current summaries; when caller retains last complete evidence alongside partial observations its original summary nodes are marked stale with original references. Original focus stays present as stale or missing, never rebinds by subject name. Previous/current comparison continuity is explicit and source/domain/epochs remain guarded. Failed construction/publication preserves retained originals and caller selection.
limits: Reuse 16 subjects, 128 selected frame details, node16KiB/1024values/depth16, graph786432bytes/32768values/320nodes/512edges, existing cached frontend/display and process budgets. At most 16 explicit comparisons. Complete evidence retains original frame/identity/comparison budgets. Every overflow refuses before publication; no truncation, widened budget or silent missing reference.
checks: Actual separately owned /2 readers and immutable frame/identity creation, x64 and Win32; derivation/projection/comparison/retrieval dispatch no API call and do not change actual reader ownership.

Independent full-content/reference digests, every compact resource summary/collision count and full comparison changed fields; complete original detail rows and exact identifiers/names remain available.

Same-domain unchanged/changed and incomparable reports; weak identifiers, duplicates/collisions, conflicts, different labels, byte-exact 36-unit names, 256-byte identifiers and maximum128details; no physical identity/freshness or mutation admission.

All cached CLI/shell/TUI/GUI model inspections/displays preserve exact compact rows and references, inert display, unknown storage authority and current/stale/missing focus. Preserve originals on graph/display/allocation refusal.

Forged current binding, mismatched frame/identity, foreign domain, wrong comparison digest/subjects, duplicates/exhaustion and unknown reference kinds/digests refuse without I/O or replacing originals. Destroyed prior projection retains only required previous values.

Clean pinned-source native builds/launches/imports and relevant regression campaigns, fresh product qualification whenever a product input changes, source/blob/hash/tooling/context/manifest evidence and accurate partial handoff.
